ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina.en:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in HEMATOWN?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.
